manifest.name: dsh-crawshrimp-data
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）本地 JSON、CSV、Excel 数据预览、统计、转换与导出工具 | Local JSON, CSV and Excel tools for DSH

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/tables.js && node --check lib/transform.js && node --check lib/permissions.js

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: crawshrimp-data
      name: dsh-crawshrimp-data
      config:
        workspaceDir: !!js process.env.DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE ?? process.cwd()

readme.section: 抓虾数据插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）CSV / Excel / JSON
readme.text:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data/releases) · [DSH Plugin topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

抓虾数据工具是面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的独立本地数据插件，可在 DSH 进程内预览、统计、清洗和导出 JSON、CSV、Excel（XLSX）数据。它适合商品表检查、库存汇总、订单数据整理，以及把浏览器或脚本产物转换成新的表格文件。无需安装抓虾应用或后端，也不需要抓虾 API Token、Python 运行时或其他配套插件；这是独立社区项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方插件。

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH **0.2.1-alpha.4**。通过 GitHub Release 安装预打包版本，或直接安装带 JavaScript 产物的 GitHub 标签：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data#v0.2.1
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce
```

无需执行包构建脚本。也可以克隆仓库后执行 `npm ci`，再安装本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w /absolute/path/to/dsh-crawshrimp-data
```

`DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE` 指定插件使用的工作目录；未指定时默认使用 DSH 启动目录。也可以在 profile patch 中覆盖完整配置：

```yaml
- id: crawshrimp-data
  config:
    workspaceDir: /absolute/path/to/data
```

详细安装方式见 [官方 bundle 安装文档](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。项目通过 GitHub 分发，未假定已经发布到 npm 注册表。

| 工具 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_data_preview` | 读取 JSON、CSV、XLSX，选择工作表，按页返回最多 100 行 |
| `crawshrimp_data_profile` | 统计缺失值、不同值数量，以及数值列的最小值、最大值、合计和均值 |
| `crawshrimp_data_export` | 将 JSON 记录写入新的 CSV 或 XLSX 文件；不会覆盖已有文件 |
| `crawshrimp_data_transform` | 声明式筛选、去重、排序、选列和重命名；可只预览或保存新文件 |

文件读取和写入限定在配置的 `workspaceDir`。写文件使用 DSH 原生审批信号：当会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有完全权限授予，插件不会重复请求逐次审批；其他状态继续走原生审批路径，无法获得审批时故障关闭。插件不会覆盖已有文件，同一插件实例的会话共享该工作目录。

可以直接对 DSH 说：

> 预览 `products.xlsx`，统计缺失价格和库存，然后把选定记录导出到 `products-clean.csv`。

工具调用可以传入 JSON 记录：

```json
{
  "path": "products-clean.csv",
  "rows": [
    { "sku": "A001", "price": 39.5, "stock": 8 },

将该对象交给 `crawshrimp_data_export`，再用 `crawshrimp_data_profile` 读取 `{"path":"products.xlsx"}`。以零开头的货号必须传为 JSON 字符串，例如 `"00123"`。CSV 导出会为可能被表格软件识别为公式的文本（含表头）加前置单引号；XLSX 文本保持字面值。

readme.section: 商品表清洗与脚本衔接
readme.text:
JSON 输入可以是记录数组，也可以是脚本产物 `{ "success": true, "data": [...] }`。明确声明 `success: false` 的失败产物会被拒绝。记录必须由扁平标量字段组成；`001` 等标识符作为字符串保持原样。JSON 的 `null` 与空字符串在内部保持区别，CSV/XLSX 写入时 `null` 表示空单元格。空数组可以通过 `{ "columns": [...], "data": [] }` 声明表头。

调用 `crawshrimp_data_transform` 可以使用以下计划：

```json
{
  "path": "products.json",
  "filters": [{ "column": "stock", "op": "gt", "value": 0 }],
  "dedupeBy": ["sku"],

readme.section: 商品表清洗与脚本衔接
readme.text: 不传 `outputPath` 时只计算预览、行数和统计；加上 `"outputPath": "products-clean.xlsx"` 或 `.csv` 路径后，才会通过原生权限检查保存新文件。处理顺序固定为：筛选 → 去重（保留第一条）→ 排序 → 选列/重命名。计划中的列名都指输入列；不执行表达式、SQL 或 JavaScript。即使结果为零行，只要声明了表头，也会生成带表头的文件。`crawshrimp_data_export` 的 `rows` 为空时必须提供 `columns`。

readme.section: 商品表清洗与脚本衔接
readme.text: 筛选条件按 AND 组合：`eq`、`ne`、`contains`、`in`（传 `values`）、`gt`、`gte`、`lt`、`lte`、`is_empty`、`not_empty`。相等比较保留类型差异；CSV 单元格读出为字符串。数值比较只接受有限十进制数或对应字符串，不解析带货币符号的文本。排序默认按文本比较；要按数值排序请设置 `numeric: true`，空值和无法解析的数值排在最后。最多 20 个筛选条件和 5 个排序键。转换预览最多返回 20 行和 256 KiB，并明确报告是否截断；保存文件包含完整的有界结果。示例见 [`examples/sample-products.json`](examples/sample-products.json) 和 [`examples/transform-products.json`](examples/transform-products.json)。

- 输入支持不超过 10 MiB 的 JSON、UTF-8 CSV 和 XLSX；表格最多 10,000 行、200 列、200,000 个单元格，列名最多 256 个字符，表头必须非空且不重复。
- 导出输入最多 5 MiB JSON，单元格最多 10,000 个字符；普通预览最多返回 100 行且结果不得超过 512 KiB。
- XLSX 公式单元格只使用已保存的缓存值，没有缓存值时返回标记；公式和宏不会执行。日期不会在 CSV 与 XLSX 之间自动统一。
- XLSX 解析前会限制 ZIP 条目数量和展开大小。超出边界时会明确报错，不会静默截断大型数据。
- 目录约束是常规本地路径和软链接检查，不能替代防御其他进程并发修改软链接的操作系统沙箱。
- 插件不编辑已有复杂工作簿，不重算公式、不渲染图表，也不连接卖家账号或商家系统。
仓库的 `npm test` 覆盖真实中文 CSV/XLSX 往返、数值统计、公式文本、路径与软链接越界、拒绝覆盖、取消、实际 Cordis/DSH ToolRuntime 中的注册/审批/卸载，以及完全权限、`ask`、受限策略和审批服务缺失/异常时的权限映射。插件不调用模型 API，也不需要真实商家账号。

[浏览器插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) · [Office 插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office)。浏览器、数据和 Office 插件分别安装、可以独立运行；网页脚本和翻页能力归浏览器插件。

MIT。能力设计来自抓虾的本地产物处理流程，运行实现直接使用独立 Node 库。
0.2.1 对齐 DSH 原生完全权限策略：`danger-full-access` 与 `never` 同时成立时不重复请求审批；其他状态继续走原生审批并在无法获批时故障关闭。0.2.0 新增 JSON 产物直读和声明式表格转换；0.1.0 标签已被替代。

[简体中文](README.md) · [中文镜像](README.zh-CN.md) · [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Plugin topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Local JSON, CSV and Excel tools that run inside DSH. No Crawshrimp application, backend, Crawshrimp API token, Python runtime or companion plugin is required. This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

| Tool | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_data_preview` | Read JSON/CSV/XLSX, select an XLSX sheet, paginate up to 100 rows |
| `crawshrimp_data_profile` | Missing values, distinct counts and numeric min/max/sum/mean |
| `crawshrimp_data_export` | JSON records to a new CSV or XLSX file |
| `crawshrimp_data_transform` | Filter, deduplicate, sort, select and rename columns; preview or save |

Useful for product-table checks, inventory summaries and turning browser/script results into spreadsheets. Files stay inside the configured workspace; writes use DSH's native permission signals. A session in `danger-full-access` with native approval policy `never` already has a standing Full Access grant, so the plugin proceeds without a duplicate per-call prompt. In `ask`, or when the sandbox/approval service is missing or cannot be read, the plugin keeps the native approval path and fails closed when it cannot grant the write. Existing files are never overwritten. All sessions using this instance share its configured workspace.

Requires Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, and DSH **0.2.1-alpha.4** (the tested API version). Install a built release tarball from [Releases](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data/releases), or install the tagged sources, which already include executable JavaScript:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data#v0.2.1
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
DSH_DATA_WORKSPACE=/absolute/path/to/data dsh --profile ecommerce
```

No package lifecycle/build scripts are needed. Alternatively clone this repository, run `npm ci`, then `dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w /absolute/path/to/dsh-crawshrimp-data`. The bundle automatically inserts its plugin row. The default workspace is DSH's launch directory. Use a dedicated folder or override row `crawshrimp-data` with the complete `config` in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: crawshrimp-data
  config:
    workspaceDir: /absolute/path/to/data
```

See the [official bundle installation guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md). These packages are distributed through GitHub, not the npm registry.

Ask DSH: “Preview products.xlsx, summarize missing prices and inventory, then export the selected records to products-clean.csv.” Or call with JSON:

```json
{"path":"products-clean.csv","rows":[{"sku":"A001","price":39.5,"stock":8},{"sku":"A002","price":60.5,"stock":0}]}
```

Use that object with `crawshrimp_data_export`, then call `crawshrimp_data_profile` with `{"path":"products.xlsx"}`. CSV exports prefix formula-like strings (including headers) with an apostrophe so spreadsheet software treats them as text. XLSX strings remain literal. Preserve identifiers such as `00123` as JSON strings.

JSON input accepts a record array or `{ "success": true, "data": [...] }`, so a script artifact can be consumed directly from the configured workspace. A declared `success: false` artifact is rejected. Records are flat scalar values; leading-zero identifiers stay strings. JSON null and empty strings remain distinct internally; CSV/XLSX serialization represents null as an empty cell. An empty array can carry explicit `columns` in a `{ "columns": [...], "data": [] }` envelope.

Call `crawshrimp_data_transform` with:

```json
{
  "path": "products.json",
  "filters": [{ "column": "stock", "op": "gt", "value": 0 }],
  "dedupeBy": ["sku"],

Omit `outputPath` to compute a read-only preview and row counts. Add `"outputPath": "products-clean.xlsx"` or a `.csv` path to request native approval and write a new artifact. No expressions, SQL or JavaScript execute. The deterministic order is filter → deduplicate (keep first) → sort → select/rename; all plan column references use input names. A zero-row result still exports its declared header. `crawshrimp_data_export` also accepts optional `columns`, required for an empty `rows` array.

Filters are AND-combined: `eq`, `ne`, `contains`, `in` (use `values`), `gt/gte/lt/lte`, `is_empty`, `not_empty`. Equality is type-sensitive; CSV values are strings. Numeric comparisons accept finite decimal numbers/strings, not formatted currency. Sort defaults to lexical order; set `numeric: true` for numbers. Missing/unparseable numeric values sort last. At most 20 filters and five sort keys are accepted. Transform previews contain up to 20 rows/256 KiB and explicitly report truncation; the saved file contains the full bounded result. `crawshrimp_data_export` requires `columns` for an empty `rows` array. Examples are in [`examples/sample-products.json`](examples/sample-products.json) and [`examples/transform-products.json`](examples/transform-products.json).

Inputs are JSON records, UTF-8 CSV or XLSX up to 10 MiB; tables support 10,000 rows, 200 columns, 200,000 cells, column names up to 256 characters, unique nonempty headers and scalar cell values. Export input is capped at 5 MiB JSON, cells at 10,000 characters, and ordinary previews at 100 rows/512 KiB. Large tables fail explicitly rather than being silently truncated. XLSX formula cells use their saved cached result, or a marker when absent; formulas/macros are never evaluated. CSV and XLSX dates are not automatically normalized across formats. ZIP expansion is bounded before XLSX parsing. Filesystem confinement is a normal local path check, not an OS sandbox against another process changing symlinks concurrently.

`npm test` verifies real Unicode CSV/XLSX round trips, numeric summaries, formula-string handling, path/symlink escapes, overwrite refusal, cancellation before output, registration/approval/unload in actual Cordis + DSH ToolRuntime, and Full Access/ask/restricted/missing/error permission mappings. No model API or merchant system is used. This plugin does not edit arbitrary existing workbooks, render charts, recalculate formulas or connect to seller accounts.

[Browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) · [Office](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office). These are the three maintained functional packages; each installs separately and works without the others. Page scripts and pagination belong to Browser.

MIT. Inspired by the local artifact workflow in [Crawshrimp Harness](https://github.com/howtimeschange/crawshrimp-harness); implementation uses standalone Node libraries.
Version 0.2.1 keeps direct JSON-artifact reading and declarative table transformations, and aligns write permissions with DSH's native Full Access preset. The original 0.1.0 tag is superseded.

[浏览器插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) · [Office 插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office)。浏览器、数据和 Office 插件分别安装、可以独立运行；网页脚本和翻页能力归浏览器插件。

MIT。能力设计来自抓虾的本地产物处理流程，运行实现直接使用独立 Node 库。
0.2.1 对齐 DSH 原生完全权限策略：`danger-full-access` 与 `never` 同时成立时不重复请求审批；其他状态继续走原生审批并在无法获批时故障关闭。0.2.0 新增 JSON 产物直读和声明式表格转换；0.1.0 标签已被替代。
